content:
TEMPTATION ||| Tilt my head closer, brushing my lips against his ear ||| "What if I just confessed everything, right here?"  
BOUNDARY ||| Step back, letting the blade rest heavy in my palm ||| "I can’t answer until I understand what’s at stake."  
CONFESSION ||| Meet his gaze, letting my voice tremble slightly ||| "I fear what your questions might reveal about us."  
REVERSAL ||| Firmly grip the blade, pulling it away from him ||| "I’ll decide the terms of this conversation, not you."  
SILENCE ||| Hold my breath, feeling the weight of the moment |||
